error.atAndGeneral: Use either @ or General in a text section, not both
error.bracketOpen: Close the bracket: a directive goes between a pair, like [Red] or [>100]
error.bracketOpenColor: Close the bracket: a colour or condition goes between a pair, like [Red] or [>100]
error.calendarFirst: Place one calendar selector (B1 or B2) before the format content
error.conditionSections: Use conditions only in the first two sections
error.dateDigits: Quote literal digits in a date/time format, such as yyyy"1"
error.datePercent: Quote a literal percent sign in a date/time format
error.elapsedMeridiem: Remove AM/PM or A/P from an elapsed-time format
error.elapsedOrder: Place the elapsed-time field before ordinary fields of the same or larger unit
error.exponentCase: Use uppercase E for scientific notation, like 0.00E+00
error.exponentCommas: Remove commas between integer exponent digits, like 0E+000
error.exponentDigits: An exponent needs digits on both sides, like 0.00E+00
error.exponentMantissa: Use a decimal mantissa with an exponent, like 0.00E+00
error.fractionDenominator: A fraction needs a denominator, like ?/? or ?/16
error.fractionFiveDigits: A literal fraction denominator can have at most five digits
error.fractionFixed: Use either placeholders or a fixed number for the denominator, like ?/?? or ?/16
error.fractionInteger: Fraction fields need integer digits; quote a literal decimal point
error.fractionSlash: A fraction format has one slash between its numerator and denominator
error.generalDigits: Use either General or numeric placeholders in a section
error.generalOnce: Use General only once in each section
error.meridiemDigits: Place numeric placeholders before AM/PM or A/P
error.oneDirective: Use only one {kind, select, color {color} condition {condition} locale {locale} calendar {calendar} other {{kind}}} directive in each section
error.oneElapsed: Use one elapsed-time field per section, such as [h]:mm:ss
error.oneExponent: A scientific format has one exponent
error.quoteOpen: Close the quotation mark: text goes between a pair, like "kg"
error.quoteText: Quote text among digits, like 0 "days": d, m, y, h, s, e, g and b are date letters
error.sections: A format code has at most four sections: positive;negative;zero;text
error.subsecondClock: Use fractional seconds only with clock fields
error.subsecondZeros: Use one to three zeros for fractional seconds, such as ss.000
error.textCondition: Use conditions only in numeric sections
error.textLast: Place the text section last in the format
error.textQuote: Quote numeric and date characters in a text section
error.tooLong: A format code can have at most {max} characters
